<mujoco model="touch_pyramidal_1">
  <option timestep="0.002" cone="pyramidal"/>
  <worldbody>
    <geom type="plane" size="2 2 0.1" condim="1"/>
    <body name="box" pos="0 0 0.12" euler="0.05 -0.03 0.2">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="box" size="0.2 0.15 0.1" mass="2" condim="1"/>
      <site name="zone" type="box" size="0.5 0.5 0.5"/>
    </body>
    <body name="ball" pos="0.6 0 0.06">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom name="ball_geom" type="sphere" size="0.05" mass="0.3" condim="1"/>
      <site name="ballzone" type="sphere" size="0.2"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <sensor>
    <touch site="zone"/>
    <touch site="ballzone"/>
  </sensor>
</mujoco>

site_sizes.xml:
<mujoco model="site_sizes">
  <default>
    <site size="0.02 0.03"/>
    <default class="a">
      <site size="0.04"/>
      <default class="b">
        <site type="box"/>
      </default>
    </default>
    <default class="c">
      <site type="ellipsoid" size="0.06 0.07 0.08"/>
    </default>
    <default class="d">
      <site type="box" size="0.03" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0.1 0.2"/>
      <default class="e">
        <site size="0.04"/>
      </default>
      <default class="g">
        <site fromto="0 0.1 0 0 0.1 0.2"/>
      </default>
    </default>
    <default class="p">
      <site pos="0.1 0 0"/>
    </default>
    <default class="q">
      <site type="cylinder" size="0.03 0.04" pos="0 0 0.01"/>
    </default>
    <default class="r">
      <site euler="10 20 30"/>
    </default>
  </default>
  <worldbody>
    <site name="world_plain" type="box"/>
    <body name="b0">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom size="0.1"/>
      <site name="main_class"/>
      <site name="one_written" size="0.5"/>
      <site name="class_a" class="a"/>
      <site name="class_b_two_written" class="b" size="0.1 0.2"/>
      <site name="class_c_one_written" class="c" size="0.9"/>
      <site name="all_written" type="capsule" size="0.11 0.12 0.13"/>
      <site name="fromto_capsule" type="capsule" size="0.02" fromto="0 0 0 0 0 0.4"/>
      <site name="fromto_box_class" class="d"/>
      <site name="fromto_box_nested_class" class="e"/>
      <site name="fromto_ellipsoid" type="ellipsoid" size="0.02 0.07" fromto="0.1 -0.2 0.05 -0.3 0.4 0.25"/>
      <site name="fromto_cylinder" type="cylinder" size="0.01" fromto="0.2 0.1 0 -0.1 0.3 0.4"/>
      <frame pos="0.5 -0.25 1">
        <site name="fromto_in_a_frame" type="capsule" size="0.01" fromto="0 0 0 0.1 0.2 0.3"/>
      </frame>
      <site name="fromto_child_class" class="g"/>
      <site name="fromto_near_vertical" type="box" size="0.02" fromto="0 0 0 1e-9 0 0.4"/>
      <frame pos="0.5 0 0">
        <site name="class_fromto_in_a_frame" class="d"/>
        <site name="class_pos_in_a_frame" class="p"/>
      </frame>
      <site name="fromto_over_own_euler" class="d" euler="0 45 0"/>
      <frame childclass="q" pos="0.3 -0.2 0.1">
        <site name="frame_childclass"/>
      </frame>
      <frame childclass="q" pos="0 0.1 0">
        <frame pos="0.1 0 0">
          <site name="nested_frames"/>
        </frame>
      </frame>
      <frame pos="0.2 0 0">
        <site name="own_euler_over_class_in_a_frame" class="r" euler="0 45 0"/>
      </frame>
      <frame pos="0 0 0.3">
        <body name="b_in_a_frame" childclass="q">
          <joint type="hinge"/>
          <geom size="0.1"/>
          <site name="body_in_a_frame"/>
        </body>
      </frame>
      <body name="b1" childclass="a">
        <joint type="hinge"/>
        <geom size="0.1"/>
        <site name="childclass_a"/>
        <site name="childclass_a_two_written" size="0.3 0.4"/>
        <frame pos="0 0.3 0">
          <site name="body_childclass_in_a_frame"/>
        </frame>
        <frame childclass="q" pos="0 0.2 0">
          <site name="frame_childclass_in_body_childclass"/>
        </frame>
        <body name="b2" childclass="q">
          <joint type="hinge"/>
          <geom size="0.1"/>
          <site name="body_childclass_over_parent"/>
        </body>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>

sites_turned.xml:
<mujoco model="sites_turned">
  <compiler fusestatic="true"/>
  <default>
    <default class="f">
      <site type="capsule" size="0.02" fromto="0 0 0 0.1 0.05 0.4"/>
    </default>
    <default class="fb">
      <site type="box" size="0.02" fromto="0.1 0 0 0.1 0.3 0.4"/>
    </default>
    <default class="q">
      <site type="cylinder" size="0.03 0.04" pos="0 0 0.01"/>
    </default>
    <default class="r">
      <site euler="10 20 30"/>
    </default>
  </default>
  <worldbody>
    <frame pos="0.1 0.2 0.3" euler="30 -20 75">
      <site name="fromto_in_a_turned_frame" type="capsule" size="0.01" fromto="0 0 0 0.1 0.2 0.3"/>
      <site name="class_fromto_in_a_turned_frame" class="fb"/>
      <site name="class_euler_in_a_turned_frame" class="r"/>
    </frame>
    <body name="b" pos="0.5 0 1" euler="0 15 0">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom size="0.05"/>
      <body name="moved" pos="0.2 0.1 -0.1">
        <geom size="0.02"/>
        <site name="fused_moved_class_fromto" class="f"/>
        <site name="fused_moved_own_fromto" type="box" size="0.02" fromto="0.1 0 0 0.1 0.3 0.4"/>
        <site name="fused_moved_class_pos" class="q"/>
      </body>
      <body name="turned" euler="20 40 -60">
        <geom size="0.02"/>
        <site name="fused_turned_class_fromto" class="f"/>
        <site name="fused_turned_class_euler" class="r"/>
      </body>
      <body name="moved_turned" pos="0.2 0.1 -0.1" euler="20 40 -60">
        <geom size="0.02"/>
        <site name="fused_moved_turned_class_fromto" class="f"/>
        <site name="fused_moved_turned_own_fromto" type="box" size="0.02" fromto="0.1 0 0 0.1 0.3 0.4"/>
        <site name="fused_moved_turned_class_pos" class="q"/>
        <body name="nested" pos="0 0 0.1" euler="0 0 33">
          <site name="fused_twice_class_fromto" class="f"/>
        </body>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>

segments.xml:
<mujoco model="zones_segments">
  <compiler fusestatic="true"/>
  <option timestep="0.002"/>
  <default>
    <default class="seg">
      <site type="capsule" size="0.01" fromto="0 0 -0.2 0 0 0.2"/>
    </default>
  </default>
  <worldbody>
    <geom type="plane" size="2 2 0.1"/>
    <body pos="0 0 0.099"><freejoint/><geom type="sphere" size="0.1" mass="0.3"/>
      <frame euler="0 90 0"><site name="class_turned" class="seg"/></frame>
      <frame pos="0 0 -0.1"><site name="class_moved" class="seg"/></frame>
      <body pos="0 0 -0.1">
        <site name="fused_own" type="capsule" size="0.01" fromto="0 0 -0.1 0 0 0.1"/>
      </body>
      <body pos="0.3 0 0">
        <site name="fused_aside" type="capsule" size="0.01" fromto="0 0 -0.2 0 0 0.2"/>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <sensor><touch site="class_turned"/><touch site="class_moved"/><touch site="fused_own"/>
    <touch site="fused_aside"/></sensor>
</mujoco>

<mujoco model="zone_edges_pair">
  <option timestep="0.002" gravity="0 0 0"/>
  <worldbody>
    <body pos="0 0 1"><freejoint/>
      <geom name="a" type="sphere" size="0.1" mass="0.3"/>
      <geom name="b" type="sphere" size="0.1" pos="0 0 0.15" mass="0.3"/>
      <site name="up" type="sphere" pos="0 0 0.4" size="0.05"/>
      <site name="down" type="sphere" pos="0 0 -0.3" size="0.05"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <contact><pair geom1="a" geom2="b"/></contact>
  <sensor><touch site="up"/><touch site="down"/></sensor>
</mujoco>
